column2: Hi there, thank you for calling Contoso, my name is Sam, how can I help you today?
Hi Sam, I am calling to cancel my Contoso insurance.
It is due to end soon.
I received a new quote from another company and it was a lot cheaper.
That is great! But before you go ahead with canceling your insurance, let me tell you why that would be a mistake.
Well, first of all, our policy is only $20 more than the other insurance company's policy.
You also have to consider the fact that our insurance has fewer clauses than the other company.
And most importantly our policy comes with bonus features like vacation flight and emergency cash.
It is important that you weigh these three factors when deciding between canceling your insurance and keeping it.
Okay, I understand your argument Sam. But still, I have decided to cancel my insurance from Contoso.
Okay, that's fine if you've made up your mind.
Before you hang up, please tell me how I can improve our service so that you might consider coming back in the future?
How can we keep you as a customer?
What else can we do for you?
Making your policies cheaper would be great.
Alright! Thank you for your feedback and we hope to earn your business in the future!
